meta.name: fog_headland_harbour
meta.prompt: A fog-bound fishing harbour on a rocky Atlantic headland: a stone lighthouse on the point above the boats, net lofts along the quay, a chapel for the drowned.

tokens.terrain: a rocky Atlantic headland jutting into open cold sea with a sheltered fishing harbour below
tokens.icons: a stone lighthouse on the high rocky point above the moored boats; weathered net lofts and fish houses along the stone quay; a small stone chapel for the drowned overlooking the water
